meta.description: Log of koolestpro-adlibrary-weekly scheduled task runs. Each entry records which rotation slot ran, how many leads were pushed to KoolestFlow, and any errors.

runs.note: 10 ads returned. 3 mega-brands filtered (Temu, Jumia, Bigbasket), 2 in-run duplicates skipped, 5 pushed. QUALITY FLAG: all 5 are AI photo/selfie mobile-app advertisers whose ad copy merely mentions fashion, not Nigerian fashion e-commerce brands. All link to play.google.com, so website/track came back null and 4 of 5 landed 'Needs Review'. The 'fashion' keyword matches ad text, not advertiser category. Worth adding an app-store-destination exclusion and/or a more specific keyword before the next fashion slot.

runs.keywordUsed: kids (re-run with location_hint='Lagos' fix, not a new rotation slot)
runs.note: Ad-hoc verification run after the first two real NG runs today (skincare, kids, home decor) all returned 0-3 genuinely Nigerian leads out of 10 raw ads each - discovered that appending the city as literal search text ('kids Lagos' vs 'kids') dramatically changes result relevance, since country=NG/is_targeted_country params don't. build_ad_library_url() now always appends --city (or 'Nigeria' as fallback) to the search keyword for NG runs - see script docstring and growth plan Build Log 2026-08-27 for full detail. Also fixed has_nigeria_signal() to check page_name in addition to ad body text and link_url - it was missing signals like 'Lagos' or '.ng' sitting in the business's own page name (Zoom Exclusive Dental Care Lagos, Bookstheylove.ng). Verified persistence held for 60s after push. Note: Burger King Nigeria was NOT filtered as a mega-brand (only 5785 page likes on this specific page) despite being a large international franchise, not really a fit for a from-scratch website pitch since they already have burgerkingng.com - like-count-only mega-brand filtering has this blind spot, flagged for Ridwan's manual review rather than auto-filtered (no reliable automated way to detect 'famous chain' vs 'local business' from this actor's data alone).

10 raw ads for NG/home decor, only 1 cleared the Nigeria-signal check: Gu-homes.ng (Track Build, instagram.com/home_decor_store_in_lagos, fit_score 70, medium confidence). This is a low yield run - 9 of 10 ads had no detectable Nigeria signal in page name/body/link despite the --city='Lagos' append, including a couple with 'ng'-adjacent names (Houseofbasketsng) that still didn't trip the checker; worth a look if home decor keeps underperforming other niches. No mega-brands this run. Queued to pending-push per the hybrid pipeline (2026-09-01) - not pushed to KoolestFlow from this cloud run; Ridwan's Mac-side launchd importer (import_pending_push.sh) will drain it into local KoolestFlow and record the ledger on next run.

10 raw ads for NG/food, 0 cleared filters. Power Oil (296,545 page likes, matched 3 separate ads) is a well-known Nigerian cooking-oil brand (PZ Wilmar) - correctly caught by the mega-brand like-count filter, but flagging per rule 6 since it's a recognizable national brand, not just a generic big-follower page. The other 7 ads (Bussin Grills Marketing, Bambau Cafe, Hub Topmost, Funmi's kitchen, Boatnaija.com, mayschills x2) had no detectable Nigeria signal in page name/body/link despite the --city='Lagos' append - 'Funmi' and 'Boatnaija.com' read like plausible Nigerian names/domains but didn't trip the automated checker, worth Ridwan's eyeball if food keeps underperforming. Queued (0 prospects) to pending-push per the hybrid pipeline - not pushed to KoolestFlow from this cloud run.

10 raw ads for NG/fashion Lagos. 9 failed the Nigeria-signal check (sufiguccii twice). The only one to clear filters, AristoMan Luxury (Scale, aristomanluxury.com, 90/100, 1,263 likes), was already in the taken-brands ledger (taken 2026-09-01), so 0 new leads. It was first queued because the --queue path didn't check the ledger; fixed same day in ad_library_koolestflow_bridge.py (ledger + in-batch dedupe before queueing, and no file is written when 0 prospects remain). The queue file was moved to pending-push/failed/. No recognizable chains in the batch.
